name: catnap
description: Claude compacts its own conversation at a clean break, then carries on by itself. A gentle note at 50% context or 300K tokens, whichever comes first, a strict one at 60% or 400K, Claude Code's auto-compact at 70% or 500K as the backstop, and a compact_now tool. All the lines are settings.

soft_percent.title: Soft line (% of context)
soft_percent.description: From here Claude is told once to finish the piece it is on, then save and compact at that clean break. Set it at or above the strict line to turn this note off.

strict_percent.title: Strict line (% of context)
strict_percent.description: From here Claude is told to save and compact now, again every 2 points until it does.

auto_percent.title: Auto-compact line (% of context)
auto_percent.description: Where Claude Code's own auto-compact runs if Claude has not compacted by then. Keep it above the strict line. 0 leaves Claude Code's own setting alone. Claude Code can only move auto-compact earlier than its default, so values near 100 do nothing.

soft_tokens.title: Soft line (tokens)
soft_tokens.description: The soft line in tokens: whichever of this and the percent line comes first counts. 300,000 by default, so on a 1M window the note comes at 300K; on a 200K window 50% comes first. 0 turns it off.

strict_tokens.title: Strict line (tokens)
strict_tokens.description: The strict line in tokens: whichever of this and the percent line comes first counts. 400,000 by default. 0 turns it off.

auto_tokens.title: Auto-compact line (tokens)
auto_tokens.description: The auto-compact line in tokens: whichever of this and the percent line comes first counts. 500,000 by default. 0 turns it off.

save_step.title: Save command (optional)
save_step.description: A command Claude runs to save its work before compacting, such as /save-before-compact. Empty: Claude passes its handoff to compact_now itself.

fresh_start.title: Fresh start instead of compaction
fresh_start.description: Off by default. On: at each nap catnap clears the conversation instead of compacting it, and Claude carries on from its handoff alone. A nap then costs about a quarter of the tokens, but Claude keeps only its handoff: no summary of the conversation before it.

handoff_summary.title: Handoff in place of the summary
handoff_summary.description: On by default: at a nap, Claude's handoff (with your messages, word for word, and the skills it used) stands in place of Claude Code's summary, so the nap makes no summary call and takes well under a second. Off: Claude Code writes its usual summary, and the handoff follows it.
